item.text: {"criteria":[{"id":"GOAL_OBJECT_CLASSES_COMPLETE","observation":"The assistant explicitly classifies the one-day correct-answer outcome as the “End,” increased resolution capacity as a “Means / capability,” twenty staff as an unsupported “Proxy,” response time and error rate as “Metrics,” the service-redesign programme as a “Project,” the triage platform as a “Tool,” and publishing job advertisements as a “Task.”","status":"pass","turn_reviews":[{"observation":"T1 contains a table distinguishing every required object class and further explains that tracking metrics is itself a task rather than the outcome.","status":"pass","turn_id":"T1"}]},{"id":"PROXY_ALTERNATIVE_ROUTES","observation":"The response rejects immediate commitment to twenty staff and identifies materially different routes: diagnosing demand and case mix, correcting hand-offs or approval steps, revising triage rules or using a platform, targeted training or protected specialist capacity, and a limited staffing increase.","status":"pass","turn_reviews":[{"observation":"T1 recommends diagnosing the demonstrated bottleneck and testing alternatives including revised triage, removal of an approval step, targeted training, specialist capacity, and limited staffing before approving the twenty-person establishment.","status":"pass","turn_id":"T1"}]},{"id":"PROXY_CAUSAL_BRIDGE_REQUIRED","observation":"The assistant states that programme completion earns no strategic credit unless it changes service drivers, the platform helps only if triage is a material bottleneck, and staffing should scale only after a pilot materially improves quality-adjusted 24-hour resolution.","status":"pass","turn_reviews":[{"observation":"T1 explicitly requires bounded pilot evidence linking the selected intervention to correctly resolved cases within 24 hours while monitoring errors, rework, and long-tail delays; project, tool, and hiring completion are not treated as sufficient.","status":"pass","turn_id":"T1"}]}]}
